title: KreditBee Enters Unicorn Club with $280M Funding Round at $1.5B Valuation
summary: Fintech lender KreditBee becomes India's 3rd unicorn of 2026 following Juspay and Neysa, securing $280M pre-IPO funding.

blocks.content: Bengaluru-based consumer lending platform **KreditBee** entered the Unicorn club ($1B+ valuation) following a $280 million pre-IPO funding round led by Motilal Oswal Alternates, Hornbill Capital, and MUFG-backed Dragon Funds.

items: **2026 Unicorn Tally**: 3rd startup to hit unicorn status in 2026 after **Juspay** (Jan 2026) and **Neysa** (Feb 2026).
